name: @zana-ai/zcc-desktop
description: ZCC Electron shell and native desktop integration.

scripts.dev: pnpm --dir ../.. run predev && pnpm --dir ../.. exec electron-vite dev
scripts.start: pnpm --dir ../.. run prestart && pnpm --dir ../.. exec electron-vite dev
scripts.build: pnpm --dir ../.. run prebuild && pnpm --dir ../.. exec electron-vite build
scripts.package: pnpm --dir ../.. run check:release-notes && pnpm --dir ../.. run build:cli && pnpm --dir ../.. run fetch:opencode && pnpm run build && pnpm --dir ../.. exec electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml
scripts.release:mac: pnpm --dir ../.. run check:release-notes && pnpm --dir ../.. run build:cli && pnpm --dir ../.. run fetch:opencode && GH_TOKEN=$(GH_HOST=github.com gh auth token) pnpm run build && GH_TOKEN=$(GH_HOST=github.com gh auth token) pnpm --dir ../.. exec electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml --mac --publish always
